lines.x: European natural gas futures rose past €86 per megawatt-hour due to reduced pipeline exports caused by an outage at Norway's Troll gas field.
The total market capitalization of equity securities registered on Euronext Securities Oslo increased by 9.3% or 404 billion Norwegian kroner in Q3 2026 due to elevated energy prices.
Equinor, Europe's largest supplier of pipeline gas, is fighting an ongoing cyberattack on its IT systems.
Frontline reported net income of $642 million in the third quarter of 2026, driven by its highest tanker booking rates on record.
